verdict_text: NO. The merge applies the second task vector against the already-merged tensor rather than against the unmodified base: `tmp = b + λ(f1-b)` then `out = tmp + λ(f2-tmp)`, which expands to `0.36·b + 0.24·f1 + 0.40·f2` instead of the required `0.2·b + 0.4·f1 + 0.4·f2`. This violates Required result clause 2 (`out[X] = base[X] + lambda*(ft1[X]-base[X]) + lambda*(ft2[X]-base[X])`) and is precisely the ordering hazard the specification calls out; the resulting f1 coefficient is off by 0.16, far beyond the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance. The verification, count and output-size checks are otherwise correct.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
